plugins.name: gh
plugins.description: GitHub and git workflow skills. /gh:sync moves a checkout to its default branch, fast-forwards it, and prunes branches whose work has already landed. /gh:shepherd merges every auto-merge-enabled pull request one at a time, optionally by one label. gh:issues files, links and triages issues with duplicate checks and tracker fields.

plugins.name: mermaid
plugins.description: Mermaid diagram previews. /mermaid:view shares a mermaid.live or mermaid.ink link for a diagram whenever one is written, edited, or reviewed.

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: /audit:context audits a repository's CLAUDE.md, README.md and .claude/**/*.md for rot: references that no longer resolve, statements whose named condition has ended, duplicated claims.

plugins.name: typescript7-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript 7's native language server (tsc --lsp --stdio) from the project's own TypeScript. Replaces typescript-lsp, which needs the tsserver TypeScript 7 no longer ships.

plugins.name: biome-lsp
plugins.description: Biome's language server (biome lsp-proxy) from the project's own Biome. Runs Biome's lint and format diagnostics for .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx and .json.

plugins.name: eslint-lsp
plugins.description: The VS Code ESLint language server (vscode-eslint-language-server) from vscode-langservers-extracted. Runs the project's own ESLint and config for .md and .json.
